english: This is an estimate of the cost of treatment; the bill depends on the treatment the patient needs.
If the patient's condition or ward changes (for example to the ICU), you will be told the new estimate.
Every service is priced from the hospital's tariff, available at the reception.

اگر مریض کی حالت یا وارڈ بدلے (مثلاً آئی سی یو) تو آپ کو نیا تخمینہ بتایا جائے گا۔
